newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary APV sells 85 pct Metalloglobus stake.
newsitem.headline: Hungary APV sells 85 pct Metalloglobus stake.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt said on Thursday it decided to sell a 85 percent state stake in metal container company Metalloglobus Rt to the a consortium of one Austrian and two Hungarian firms.
"The offered price was 363.7 million forints plus $860,000," APV said in a statement.

The buyers and sole bidder, a consortium of Metglob Tanacsado Kft, Metagenta Nova Kft and Fermetall Handellsegesellshaft GmbH also undertook to buy any shares remaining after the employee share offer of 15 percent.
APV will keep one preference share giving it special rights until the new owner has fulfilled all its contractual obligations.
The new owner will have to implement environmental rehabilitation and pay any fines imposed on Metalloglobus for environmental damage.
An APV source said a court case against Metalloglobus's Metallochemia unit brought by the Budapest district council where the plant is located and local residents was currently pending.
The plaintiffs are claiming 5.6 billion forints' compensation for damage caused mainly by accumulated lead contamination.
The consortium also undertook to raise the capital of Metalloglobus by 150 million forints within 180 days of the purchase and that it will invest 800 to 900 million forints by the year 2000.
